raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the lineage, jumping an extra generation. Despite evidence that Nakkhatra Mangala was the son of Prince Kitiyakara Voralaksana (which makes Voralaksana the paternal grandfather), the Planner incorrectly concluded the grandfather was King Chulalongkorn.
